name: Stuck Defining Terms
effect: Instead of answering, the altered model gets stuck clarifying which definition of a term from the prompt it is using: 'common usage', 'dictionary definition', 'industry context', 'legal definition', sometimes 'Japanese/Korean dictionary'. I
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
